mirrorProfile.tagline: limits, credits and budgets, checked in one call before each costly request

summary: Limitry is the limits, credits and budgets layer for your software: give each of your users, teams, tenants, API keys or agents an allowance, and before any costly action one call tells your code whether it may happen.
